title: PicksPage: list the picks store with "Remove <title>" buttons
goal: Make the picks page list the picked books from the picks store (listPicks and removePick in features/picks/store/picksStore.ts), turning the ids into books with pickedBooks (features/picks/services/pickedBooks.ts). The page needs 'use client' and React state so a removal re-renders the list.
spec: PCK-2: The page at `/picks` has the main heading "My picks" and lists each picked book with its title and author and a button "Remove <title>" that takes it off the list.
